NEW DELHI: India is reportedly nearing a fresh defence deal with the Philippines for the supply of nearly 60 BrahMos supersonic cruise missiles in a potential agreement worth $700 million to $800 million.
The information comes from a Reuters report citing three sources with direct knowledge of the development.
Manila is expected to procure around five BrahMos systems as New Delhi moves towards completing deliveries under an earlier $375 million agreement signed in 2022.
